description.value: The eidolon carves into their foe in a gruesome display. The eidolon makes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike}. The Strike deals @Damage[(@actor.level)[persistent,bleed]] damage and each enemy within 15 feet of the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:spell] save against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (sickened 2 on a critical failure). Creatures that succeed their save are immune to further attempts to sicken them from Exemplify the Profane.
